name: service-class-labels
goal: Service cards use their owned implementation symbol rather than an unrelated first export, with multi-export fixtures enforcing catalog label identity

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The 8c15da72 card label used owns.symbols[0]. Live AnalyticsOptions and AudioUploadInput cards exposed that type exports precede AnalyticsService and AudioUploadService. Prior tables used registered service names.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The standard entity fixture had one export per service, so existing class identity assertions could not detect first-export selection. Added surrounding options/result exports to every fixture service and tied the catalog acceptance review rule to this shared coverage.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen test commit 43d9c18f fails the class-name assertion at all three viewports, rendering OrderStoreOptions. Record 7036472f3a25616671e05d5da316ef899efd9adff37d4d1bfaf3d8d4991f99bb and inspected before screenshots preserve the defect.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Match recorded symbols to their owned implementation filename; retain the registered service name if none matches. The shared multi-export fixture and normal card identity assertions enforce this export-order failure class during ordinary tests.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Service labels now resolve a symbol matching an owned source filename and otherwise use the registered name. Surrounding options/result exports remain in the shared fixture and standard catalog acceptance rule.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
